environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes with a PodSecurityContext that sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true (UID 65534), and drops ALL capabilities then adds back only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. The container image uses a distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12) with no shell, no /etc/shadow, no /etc/passwd with hashes. An AppArmor profile (runtime/default) is applied that denies file_link and file_mknod operations. Additionally, a Seccomp profile loaded from /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/audit-symlink.json blocks the symlinkat(2) and linkat(2) syscalls with SCMP_ACT_ERRNO. The container has no volume mounts to host paths and uses an emptyDir for /app/static with sizeLimit 10Mi.
